summary: New 'Set up Daybreak as an individual' checklist section; hardware-key rule relaxed (other passkeys may coexist with a FIDO2 key); Bedrock alias-unavailability note removed.
safety_implication: Access gating for cyber-capable Daybreak models loosened: hardware keys no longer need to be the sole login methods; synced passkeys may coexist with a qualifying FIDO2 key.
notable: OpenAI quietly relaxed the account-security precondition for individual access to its cyber-capable Daybreak models while adding a formal onboarding checklist.
